hostKey.title: Unknown host key
hostKey.message: The authenticity of {{host}}:{{port}} can't be established. Accept this key to continue connecting?
hostKey.changedMessage: The host key for {{host}}:{{port}} is different from the one previously saved. This can happen after a server reinstall but it can also mean someone is intercepting the connection.
hostKey.changedWarning: Only continue if you were expecting this change.
hostKey.changedHint: Accepting will replace the old key in ~/.ssh/known_hosts.
hostKey.hint: It will be saved to ~/.ssh/known_hosts and trusted on future connections.

profile.name: Profile name
profile.usernameHint: Changing this renames the account on every connection using this profile.
profile.passwordHint: Stored in your operating system's keystore, never in the app database. Leave empty to be asked at connection time.
profile.duplicate: A profile with this name already exists.
profile.usernameCollision: Another connection already uses that username on the same host and port.

profileDelete.title: Delete credential profile
profileDelete.message: Delete “{{name}}”? Its saved password is removed from the keystore. This cannot be undone.
profileDelete.messageInUse_one: Delete “{{name}}”? {{count}} connection uses it: it keeps its username but loses the shared password, and you'll be asked for one on the next connection.
profileDelete.messageInUse_other: Delete “{{name}}”? {{count}} connections use it: they keep their username but lose the shared password, and you'll be asked for one on the next connection.

profileForgetPassword.title: Forget profile password
profileForgetPassword.message: Remove the password saved for “{{name}}” from the keystore? Every connection using this profile will ask for it again.
